snippet.title: The Silence: The Forest Out Now on Microsoft Store
snippet.description:
The Silence: The Forest - Out Now On Microsoft Store

The Silence is not safe... but now... in Microsoft Store

The official launch of *The Silence: The Forest* marks a significant moment, as a remake is currently in development and the game is expanding to other platforms.

Download the Game:

Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nccf861lwdb?hl=en-GB&gl=NZ
